_comment: Bindings for the Gabe Suite's OWN command center. This is a FORK of the standard center (templates/center/, copied from HEAD ebfa82b) re-pointed at the suite itself. The suite is not an application: it has no endpoints, no models, no runtime, and per ruling R8 no .kdbp/. So the spine is the LIFECYCLE BEAT, not an application entity, and the lenses are the suite's own material: agents, formats, functions, data structures, hooks, testing, and the enforcement ledger. Nothing here is shared with templates/center/ — that template stays owned by /gabe-adopt and /gabe-feature for downstream projects.
_beats_comment: The filter spine. Nine lifecycle beats + satellites, plus two non-beat homes (cross-cutting, suite-maintenance) so contracts like E1-E7 and the doctor's own invariants have an honest place to sit rather than being forced into a beat they do not belong to.
_buckets_comment: The accountability taxonomy. Order is the ledger's default sort: what we actually enforce, what we owe, what can only ever be prompted, and what we falsely claim. `payable` marks the two buckets that represent work someone can do.

buckets.label: Hard-enforced
buckets.blurb: A machine check exists AND runs. Something acts on the non-zero exit, or a build dies.

buckets.label: Hardenable
buckets.blurb: Could be checked mechanically and isn't. Payable debt — each one names the check that would close it.

buckets.label: Prompt-only
buckets.blurb: A judgment no script can adjudicate. Accountability here is the disclosure carrier: which file states it, at what depth, and is it reachable when the rule must fire?

buckets.label: Broken claim
buckets.blurb: The suite asserts enforcement that does not exist, or a mechanism that describes itself falsely. Highest urgency — these actively mislead.

_lenses_comment: The estate. `group` is the nav grouping; `spike` records which cut a lens landed in. Only shipped lenses get a nav entry — an unshipped one is listed and visibly disabled rather than omitted (absent reads as 'does not exist') or 404ing (reads as broken).

lenses.label: Board
lenses.blurb: Every open move the suite is carrying, projected from five committed sources — six framings, State is the landing one.

lenses.label: Enforcement ledger
lenses.blurb: Every rule the suite asserts, classified by whether we can enforce it, do enforce it, or only claim to.

lenses.label: Hooks
lenses.blurb: The six shipped hooks: slot, matcher, every reachable exit code, every fail-open path, and fixture coverage.

lenses.label: Testing
lenses.blurb: The fixture batteries that give every other gate its teeth — and the gates that have no battery at all.

lenses.label: Agents
lenses.blurb: The subagent surface: which beats fork, which run read-only, and what the harness exposes.

lenses.label: Format methods
lenses.blurb: Literal output-string contracts — the byte-identical strings, E1-E7 output shapes, trailers and glyph sets — and where they have drifted.

lenses.label: Functions
lenses.blurb: Every function the suite's own scripts define, across python, shell and mjs.

lenses.label: Data structures
lenses.blurb: Every artifact shape the lifecycle reads or writes, and whether a validator stands behind it.

_provenance_comment: Where the fork came from, so drift against the upstream template is answerable. The standard center template is NOT a dependency of this build — the shell is vendored under docs/center/shell/.

provenance.reason: The working tree's center generators were mid-edit in a parallel session and tests/center/run.sh was red; the fork takes the committed, doctor-green baseline.
